messages:
alex: heads-up — customer reported widespread 5xxs from the hosted API over the last ~10m. ticket #4321. sample error: 502 Gateway Error with body: `{\"error\":\"control_plane_unavailable\",\"component\":\"routing-policy\",\"code\":500}`. correlation-id: c-id=3f9b2a. anyone seeing this?

sam: confirmed. seeing elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings for a handful of customers in us-east-1. latency spikes then 5xx. some 401-like auth failures mixed in. forwarding customer logs.

mira: pinging infra metrics — auth-service error-rate jumped at 1767501187, routing-policy latency spiking. looks like config-db timeouts around the same time (avg p95 connection latency 3.2s).

jon: pulling k8s events for control-plane namespace. saw `Readiness probe failed` on `config-db-primary-0` then a bunch of connection timeouts. possible brief failover.

tara: are these related to the config push we did 12m ago? I merged the routing policy update that changes prefer-local-region routing.

mira: can you hold further config pushes? if routing-policy was just changed we might be hitting a bad code path that exacerbates DB load.

alex: repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/generate with model=redwood-alpha 2) request hangs ~2-3s then returns 502. headers: `x-rw-correlation: 3f9b2a`, `x-rw-route: route-12`. attaching stack snips.

mira: digging into logs — routing-policy service is doing sync reads from config-db per request for the new policy (should be cached). stack shows `pg: canceling statement due to statement timeout` and then `error: upstream auth service failed: 500`.

jon: config-db is under heavy load, many long queries. I see repeated `SELECT * FROM policies WHERE ...` with no index on the filter (the new query path looks unoptimized).

tara: oof. that change added a region filter that uses `metadata->>'region'` which we didn't index. that explains table scans.

mira: mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback cached route for routing-policy (flip to cached-mode) 2) increase DB statement timeout to avoid long blocking 3) restart routing-policy and auth-service pods to clear unhealthy connections 4) rollback the routing-policy code path if needed. who can flip cached-mode?

jon: I can flip cached-mode via the config toggle in the control plane: `POST /admin/toggles/routing-policy/cached-mode` with body `{"enabled":true}`. doing it now.

incidents-bot: [alert] incident created: INC-2026-03-15-02. severity: high. participants: mira, jon, alex.

jon: toggle succeeded — cached-mode ON. observability: routing-policy request rate unchanged but DB queries dropped by ~70% within 30s. auth-service still showing elevated 500s, likely downstream dependency.

mira: rolling restart auth-service now to clear stuck connections: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-service -n control-plane`. watch for error ripples.

alex: customer updated — errors decreased immediately after the cache toggle, they still see occasional 502s but rate is much lower. adding status update to ticket. :thumbsup:

jon: restarted routing-policy also to pick up cached-mode config. pods back and healthy. DB slow queries almost gone. p95 auth latency down from 1.6s -> 0.22s.

mira: performing a quick post-action check: sample responses now 200 with normal body, correlation-id `3f9b2a` returns follow-up trace showing success.

tara: I'm rolling back the exact change that used the unindexed JSON filter and will open a PR with an indexed column + migration to avoid this in future.

alex: customer notified of mitigation and temporary fix; ticket updated with ETA for full fix (PR + migration).

mira: follow-ups: - postmortem to include why cached-mode wasn't used by default for that code path - add index on `policies(metadata->>'region')` or push region into dedicated column - add circuit-breaker and queued retries between routing-policy and config-db - add dashboard alert for DB long queries affecting control-plane.

jon: recording commands we ran: `POST /admin/toggles/routing-policy/cached-mode {\"enabled\":true}`, `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-service -n control-plane`, `kubectl rollout restart deployment/routing-policy -n control-plane`.

alex: closing thread for now — errors back to baseline and customers are OK. assigning owners: tara for code fix, jon for DB index/migration, mira for postmortem writeup. will keep INC-2026 ticket open until migration deployed.

sam: thanks team — great quick response.

mira: I'll start a draft postmortem and drop in #postmortems later today.

jon: adding runbook item: if config-db p95 > 1s and routing-policy 5xx > 1% then flip cached-mode and consider traffic throttle.

alex: note for support: if customers hit these 5xxs, ask for correlation-id and zone, and confirm whether errors are persistent after 2m (we have auto-mitigation in 30-90s currently).

incidents-bot: incident INC-2026-03-15-02 updated: mitigated (status: monitoring).
